findings_summary.headline: The persistent call tag and work-order card make the miss, leak, recovery, human hold, stop route, booking, and measurement chain understandable; four localized hierarchy and timing issues remain before creative approval.
findings_summary.recommendation: Correct the opening time contradiction, slow the source-field extraction, make the human action primary at the gate, and lengthen the completed measurement hold; then repeat the same four independent editorial passes.

acceptance_checks.check: recompute every pinned input hash before review
acceptance_checks.notes: All seven issued SHA-256 pins were recomputed before the MP4 and contact sheets were reviewed, and every value matched exactly.

acceptance_checks.check: watch the rendered MP4 as an audience member without relying on production notes
acceptance_checks.notes: The actual 61.433333-second MP4 was played from beginning to end before the locked visual-plan obligations were consulted.

acceptance_checks.check: run separate comprehension, rhythm, hierarchy, and phone-sized legibility passes
acceptance_checks.notes: review.md records four separately executed passes; the phone pass replayed the MP4 at a 480x270 viewport and also inspected the pinned 480x270 contact sheet.

acceptance_checks.check: test whether the current path, leak, recovery route, human gate, stop path, booked outcome, and one-week measure are inferable
acceptance_checks.notes: All seven required inferences are recoverable from the locked narration and rendered objects; qualified weaknesses are recorded for the continuation mark, human-gate hierarchy, and final measurement hold.

acceptance_checks.check: identify slide, dashboard, Prezi, decorative-motion, over-text, or competing-focus failures with timestamps
acceptance_checks.notes: No systemic slide, dashboard, Prezi, or decorative-motion failure was observed. Timestamped density and competing-focus issues are reported at 27.80-32.25, 34.20-39.88, and 47.68-49.50.

acceptance_checks.check: return ranked blocking, major, and minor findings and distinguish creative judgment from technical validity
acceptance_checks.notes: review.md records zero blocking, four major, and three minor editorial findings. The ffprobe observations are explicitly separated from creative judgment and do not claim a technical gate.

acceptance_checks.check: state explicitly that no gate approval or state change is claimed
acceptance_checks.notes: The review and manifest state explicitly that packet completion is not creative or production approval and that no experiment or production state changed.

assumptions: The locked narration and rendered audio are intended to be experienced together; comprehension findings therefore judge what an audience can infer from voice plus picture, not a silent-film test.
The conspicuous asset placeholders are intentional rehearsal material and were judged for editorial role and hierarchy rather than photographic finish.
The browser-native playback controls are not part of the render; their effect at 480x270 is used only to explain why the already-short final authored hold has little practical margin.
deliverable.json omits its own SHA-256 from outputs because a final file cannot truthfully contain its own final SHA-256; review.md is the independently hashable content output.
